LanguageData.VRE_DeadVoice.description: Carriers of this gene have a raspy, sickly voice.
LanguageData.VRE_DeadVoice.label: dead voice
LanguageData.VRE_ExtremeSkillLoss.description: Carriers of this gene forget skills twice as fast.
LanguageData.VRE_ExtremeSkillLoss.label: extreme skill loss
LanguageData.VRE_FungalArmor.description: Carriers of this gene have fungal weave in their skin, greatly decreasing incoming damage. The effects increase in severity with time.
LanguageData.VRE_FungalArmor.label: fungal armor
LanguageData.VRE_FungalCrest.description: Carriers of this gene grow a large, colorful fungal crest protruding from the top of their head.
LanguageData.VRE_FungalCrest.label: fungal crest
LanguageData.VRE_FungalFlesh.description: Carriers of this gene have fungal matter in their flesh. Consuming any fungus by them is classed as cannibalism.
LanguageData.VRE_FungalFlesh.label: fungal flesh
LanguageData.VRE_FungalRegeneration.description: Carriers of this gene are capable of fungal regeneration. The effects increase in severity with time.
LanguageData.VRE_FungalRegeneration.label: fungal regeneration
LanguageData.VRE_Fungoid_Hair_DarkTan.label: dark tan hair
LanguageData.VRE_Fungoid_Hair_MistyMoss.label: misty moss hair
LanguageData.VRE_Fungoid_Hair_RoseTaupe.label: rose taupe hair
LanguageData.VRE_Fungoid_Hair_Salmon.label: salmon hair
LanguageData.VRE_Fungoid_Hair_SwampGreen.label: swamp green hair
LanguageData.VRE_Fungoid_Hair_Tumbleweed.label: tumbleweed hair
LanguageData.VRE_Fungoid_Hair_Wenge.label: wenge hair
LanguageData.VRE_GeneInfector.description: Carriers of this gene implant a copy of their xenogerm into another person through attacks with their claws or teeth. This in turn triggers a progressing infection in the victim, which if left untreated will apply the carrier’s xenogerm to them.
LanguageData.VRE_GeneInfector.label: gene infector
LanguageData.VRE_HairMushroom.label: fungal hair
LanguageData.VRE_MindCoalescence.description: Carriers of this gene have a psychic connection to other carriers, allowing them to share some of the emotions with them. A portion of average happiness gets shared with mind coalescent individuals. Due to that, they also all share mental states and suffer them at the same time.
LanguageData.VRE_MindCoalescence.label: mind coalescence
LanguageData.VRE_MinorSkillLoss.description: Carriers of this gene forget skills half as slow.
LanguageData.VRE_MinorSkillLoss.label: minor skill loss
LanguageData.VRE_NoSkillLoss.description: Carriers of this gene do not suffer from forgetting skills.
LanguageData.VRE_NoSkillLoss.label: no skill loss
LanguageData.VRE_NoStudy.description: Carriers of this gene are incapable of learning new skills.
LanguageData.VRE_NoStudy.label: no study
LanguageData.VRE_PartialAntirotLungs.description: Carriers of this gene build up rot stink exposure slower.
LanguageData.VRE_PartialAntirotLungs.label: partial antirot lungs
LanguageData.VRE_Repulsive.description: Carriers of this gene have twisted, unnatural, terrifying looks. They barely resemble humans. Any social interactions with them make people sick.
LanguageData.VRE_Repulsive.label: repulsive
LanguageData.VRE_RotBlood.description: Carriers of this gene bleed stinking rot blood.
LanguageData.VRE_RotBlood.label: rotblood
LanguageData.VRE_SevereSkillLoss.description: Carriers of this gene forget skills 50% faster.
LanguageData.VRE_SevereSkillLoss.label: severe skill loss
LanguageData.VRE_SkillDegradation.description: Carriers of this gene suffer from forgetting skills regardless of their current skill level.
LanguageData.VRE_SkillDegradation.label: skill degradation
LanguageData.VRE_Telepathy.description: Carriers of this gene can communicate with other carriers of this gene via psychic telepathy. Proximity is not required for social interactions.
LanguageData.VRE_Telepathy.label: telepathy
LanguageData.VRE_TotalAntirotLungs.description: Carriers of this gene are immune to rot stink exposure.
LanguageData.VRE_TotalAntirotLungs.label: total antirot lungs
